d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

We are seeking a passionate, energetic, and service-driven Server to join our award-winning steakhouse restaurant. The Server is responsible for delivering exceptional dining experiences by providing attentive, personalized, and professional service throughout every stage of the guest journey.
This role requires a deep commitment to hospitality excellence, menu knowledge, and the ability to create memorable experiences that exceed guest expectations.
q: Previous experience in a restaurant, hotel, resort, or hospitality environment preferred.
Fine dining or upscale restaurant experience is an advantage.
Passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional guest service.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving abilities and a guest-focused mindset.
Basic knowledge of food, beverages, wines, and service etiquette preferred.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
Good command of English; additional languages are an advantage.
Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and lift or carry restaurant equipment as required.
Positive attitude, reliability, and willingness to learn and grow within the organization.

d: Responsible to plan, organize, and manage staff and overall operations to ensure the stable running of the organization's Cyber Security. This includes developing, maintaining, supporting, and optimizing key functional areas.
Set Cyber Security unit performance objectives.

Continuously monitor progress and development towards organizational and Unit strategic objectives and communicate periodic performance reports to provide evaluation results and recommend improvements.
Develop and implement Cyber Security unit policies and procedures in order to ensure the fulfilment of organizational requirements whilst delivering high-quality services.

Carry-out the day-to-day operations of the Cyber Security Unit, provide expertise, encourage teamwork and align work processes to achieve high performance standards, meet established targets and engage employee in a motivated work environment.
Ensure the quality of services is performed in a way that meets according to the established KPI's.
Ensure the services' availability and reliability, which align with SLA and QoS.
Manage and improve an integrated cyber security solution that helps to protect the core infrastructure, the network, and the applications that run within the network.
Coach new/existing team members the needed technical and soft skills to perform the job effectively.
Provide training and technical support for users with varying levels of cyber security knowledge and competence.
Manage the procurement, installation, testing and developing IT and security projects.
Establish and manage the enterprise IT security policy.
Evaluate infrastructure and security proposals and recommend the required solutions that meet the security requirements.
Identify customer’s requirements correctly, exceed customer expectations and act proactively for ensuring customer satisfaction.
Perform any other related duties as assigned or needed.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, IT, Cyber Security, communication engineering, or any related field.
8 to 10 years experience in the same area in the Telecom field.
Possess solid and security technical experience.
